disclaimer: Open-source research index. Organization status, equipment, leadership, alignment and relationships can change. Follow linked primary and authoritative sources before relying on an entry.
methodology: TOC Monkey separates durable baseline profiles from automatically refreshed recent-reporting signals. Baseline profiles are source-linked and manually reviewed. The expanded Task Org layer adds AOR-wide country and defense/security reference nodes plus deeper military, maritime, militia, insurgent/terrorist and organized-crime profiles. Automated reporting may attach recent open-source signals but never rewrites baseline facts automatically.

EUCOM.focus: Europe, Russia, Black Sea, Arctic approaches and NATO's eastern flank

CENTCOM.focus: Middle East, Gulf, Levant, Iran, Iraq, Syria, Yemen and adjacent approaches

INDOPACOM.focus: Indo-Pacific, Taiwan Strait, Korean Peninsula, South China Sea and first/second island chains

AFRICOM.focus: African continent, coastal approaches, Sahel, Horn of Africa and major transnational security corridors

SOUTHCOM.focus: Central America, South America and the Caribbean, excluding Mexico

NORTHCOM.focus: United States, Canada, Mexico, Greenland, adjacent approaches and continental aerospace / maritime warning
